issue.title: note_ready scan_excludes_r3_and_r7_paths flakes under parallel cargo test

task_type_fields.evidence:
Observed during the bob-cli-52 landing on unchanged master 2d568fa (athena):
- First full parallel `just all` lib run: `native::note_ready::tests::scan_excludes_r3_and_r7_paths ... ok`.
- Second full parallel run (`cargo test --no-fail-fast --tests`) on the same tree: FAILED, panicking at src/native/note_ready/tests.rs:420 (`assert_eq!(entry.count, 1, "only the plain task counts")`).
- So far 1 failure in 2 parallel runs on the same tree. bob-cli-52.5 note #4 independently saw the note_ready r3/r7 test flake under parallel load on its clean base tree; it passed when run alone.

Not caused by bob-cli-52: that epic never touched src/native/note_ready/. A likely class is process-wide environment mutation by other parallel unit tests. Several unit tests call `env::set_var`: highlights_ref/fetch.rs (18), highlights_ref/tests/audio.rs, listen.rs, ref_jobs/kick.rs, capture_pomodoros.rs, capture_complete tests, completion, ob.rs, and highlights_ref/ingest.rs. That would be the same class as bob-cli-40 (capture_pomodoros) and bob-cli-2e, but nobody has confirmed the root cause. Investigate which env var or shared state `scan_fixture` reads, then make the test deterministic.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-52.5 proposed this flake and the bob-cli-52 landing saw it fail once and pass once on the same tree; no existing bead tracks this note_ready test.
